title: Amino Acid Biosynthesis and Carbon–Nitrogen Integration
word_count_method: Whitespace tokens in p.teaching-prose, excluding markup, questions, tables and diagrams.
comparison: Adjacent 6.C.03 has approximately 13,823 teaching-prose words by the same method; the revised 6.C.04 has comparable substantive narrative length and coverage.
coverage: Glutamate/glutamine and position-specific N donation; PLP reaction and equilibrium; Asp/Asn synthesis and transport economics; aspartate, BCAA, glutamate, aromatic, serine/glycine/cysteine and histidine families; feedback and compartmentation; ATP/electron costs; carbon skeleton replenishment; source/sink and seed filling; isotope tracing and enzyme/rescue experiments.
review: Expanded substantive teaching from roughly 6,200 to 13,056 words, 20 to 50 questions and 4 to 10 diagrams. Checked pathway overview and feedback against Galili et al. 2016 PMID 26735064, Arabidopsis aspartate-derived pathways PMC3243338, amino acid regulation PMID25114014, nitrogen remobilization PMC2887065, plant amino acid transport PMC7466100 and C/N balance PMC12018728. Reviewed calculations and answer mappings; corrected mislabeled adjacent chapter, improved zoom accessibility and focus return. Original examples and graphs are explicitly illustrative.
score_basis: Internal editorial self-assessment, not independent peer review; deductions for limited exhaustive source review, visual rendering, some simple distractors, and lack of runtime/accessibility testing.
limitations: No browser/mobile/keyboard runtime or all-reference URL verification.
GitHub Pages deployment and live availability pending.

publication.strategy: Atomic tree, non-force main ref update

checkpoint_reconciliation.basis: All linked curriculum IDs verified against chapter paths and sitemap
